facts.business: JSL Industries Limited is an Indian listed company with its registered office and plant located at Village Mogar, Anand, Gujarat.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter regarding reclassification of investment in Jyoti Limited from FVTPL to FVTOCI-NR effective 1st April 2025, resulting in fair market value of INR 527.67 lakhs and decrease in income by INR 346.55 lakhs (gross) during the year. Also Key Audit Matter on compliance with new Labour Codes notified November 21, 2025.

key_risks: Complexity in interpreting provisions of new Labour Codes and assessing applicability
Reclassification of investment in Jyoti Limited affecting financial statements
Dependence on related party transactions with promoter group company Jyoti Limited
facts.related_party_note: Material Related Party Transaction with Jyoti Limited, a Promoter Group Company, for the financial year 2026-27 requires shareholder approval. Policy on related party transactions available at https://www.jslmogar.com/investor/index/policies-codes. Details provided at point no. 25 of Boards' Report.
